name: NavigationToolbar
desc: A general structural component with left-center-right mode, which can specify the left margin of the middle component and whether it is centered. The source code is used in the structure of navigation bars such as AppBar.

fields.name: leading
fields.desc: Widget to place at the start of the horizontal toolbar.

fields.name: middle
fields.desc: Widget to place in the middle of the horizontal toolbar, occupying as much remaining space as possible.

fields.name: trailing
fields.desc: Widget to place at the end of the horizontal toolbar.

fields.name: centerMiddle
fields.desc: Whether to align the [middle] widget to the center of this widget or next to the [leading] widget when false.

fields.name: middleSpacing
fields.desc: The spacing around the [middle] widget on horizontal axis.

nodes.name: Basic Usage of NavigationToolbar
desc: 【centerMiddle】: Whether the middle component is centered   【bool】
【middleSpacing】: Distance of the middle component from the left   【double】
